title: How Sink Drainage Works: The Anatomy of a Sanitary Waste Trap
description: A properly functioning sink drainage system relies on gravity, smooth pipe transitions, and a crucial hydraulic seal known as the trap. The trap holds a standing column of water that prevents sewer gases from entering the living space through the fixture opening. Understanding how wastewater flows from the sink basin, through the tailpiece, into the trap, and out into the sanitary branch is fundamental for every drainage professional. Proper alignment and secure connections ensure leak-free operation and maintain the delicate pressure balance required for smooth, uninterrupted drainage.
